programmes.d: In an episode reminiscent of Hitchcock's Strangers on a Train, Dr. Sloan is drawn into a murder pact by a psychiatrist in need of money. The psychiatrist kills a woman pestering Dr. Sloan, expecting Mark to eliminate his problem.

A group of Satanic believers starts kidnapping children a week before Halloween so they can sacrifice them on the 31st. When Alex tries to protect a child, she is also taken. The Rangers, Carlos, and Trent track down the group.

While hiking in the Colorado mountains, Alex is kidnapped by a trio of mountain men, who force her to their backwoods cabin. Walker, Trivette, Sandoval, and Malloy follow their trail through the mountains, determined to get her back.

A former member of the IRA brings his daughter to Dallas for medical treatment. However, Irish radicals follow them to Texas to kidnap the girl and force the father to help. The Rangers must find the girl before she dies from her illness.
To celebrate Walker's birthday, CD gives a book on the early life of Hayes Cooper. CD relates the adventure of the legendary Ranger protecting a wagon train from outlaws.

Country singer Lila McCann stars as Kelly Wyman, an aspiring country singer. One of the many obstacles this precocious teenager faces is a slick-talking talent agent, who is the mastermind behind a drug cartel that Walker is trying to bring down.

In the wilderness, MacGyver and 10-year-old Darin Cooper intervene to save the lives of a pair of golden eagles injured by poachers. The poachers go after MacGyver -- witness to their crime -- and taking Darin and his mother hostage.
MacGyver fights to save a young boy from the ominous fate of a centuries-old legend.
MacGyver, Pete Thornton, and Joanne Remmings (The Phoenix Foundation's resident bunco expert) pull a sting operation against a con man who cheated their friend out of his life savings.
When their plane crashes in the wilderness, MacGyver and four teenage gang leaders struggle for survival.
Jesse is attracted to a beautiful psychic, who also happens to be the prime suspect in a murder. Amanda copes with the trials of motherhood.
The daughter of one of Mark's friends writes a juicy tell-all expose of the most prominent public figures. Mark takes her in after a crazed stalker starts threatening her and her co-authors.
Mark investigates a perky morning television personality for the murder of a Howard Stern-like radio host.
Dr. Sloan is the executor of his friend, Preston Michael's, estate after Michaels is found in the body of a shark.
A friendly-fire incident involving a veteran cop leaves Steve's friend dead, but the shooting only appears to be unintentional.
Jesse and Dr. Sloan have contact with a contagious victim of a genetically altered smallpox strain.
A skater stages an attack on herself to win endorsements, then ices her accomplice---and frames her rival for the killing.
Dr. Sloan and Steve investigate a private eye's murder in the not-very-pretty world of modeling.
